schema: SLeeLa FRUCHST frequency candidate staging v1

source.frequency_unit: occurrences per billion tokens (scaled by unilex)
source.selection: Forms NFC-normalized and stripped of edge punctuation; letterless tokens dropped; case variants merged (summed, most frequent form kept); ranked by frequency descending with code-point tie-break; first 1,000 kept. source_rank equals the re-ranked position because the upstream file is alphabetical.
limitations: Surface forms, not lemmatized headwords; case variants merged.
Web/scripture crawl (Google Corpus Crawler); not a balanced general-purpose corpus; may contain foreign-language noise.
Proper nouns (people, places, organizations) are not filtered and appear in the list.
No POS or sense labels are supplied by this source.
English, French, and Spanish definitions remain pending.
7 forms share the frequency at rank 1,000; cut by code-point order.
